problems.detail: coverage=0 means unmeasured; these are eight grouped integration checks, not line coverage.
Artifact feed absent from daemon launch arguments; no --artifacts-dir configured. Idle observer liveness does not certify ingestion of real scientific artifacts or useful auditing.
No executor/verifier installed; full autonomous repair and verified merges remain blocked. No prior merged record is evidence of a new successful repair.
No-new-damage/merge claim is limited to the observed 47.838-second window and checked persisted counters/files. Historical sleep state is retained and not asserted validated.
Live persistent processes verified only; no reboot autostart or scheduler/service recovery claim.

V2 adapter activation deliberately not inspected or changed. No production source/config edits, stop/restart, model calls, billing, MCP mutations or global edits. Python imports may create normal bytecode caches; no operational state writes requested by tester beyond observer reads and existing-live ensure_daemon checks.

Bare Get-Command opencode failed because CLI is not on PATH; resolved documented explicit existing executable and successful authenticated GET. Discovery diagnostics are not represented as MCP connection failures.

MCP connected statuses certify transport connectivity only, not model-backed tool success, subscription quota or full system restoration. Earlier unrelated health-suite fixture failures remain documented separately.
